title: Los Alamos tiger team security test failed

tellings.quote: they called it the tiger team came in to test security there, and they failed so horribly

plain: Around 1990, a so-called tiger team, a group sent in to test security by trying to break through it, came to Los Alamos, the US nuclear weapons laboratory in New Mexico, and the lab "failed so horribly". Bob Lazar, a man known for claims that he worked on secret government projects, tells it as something he was told. It would mean that one of the country's most sensitive sites had weak defences.
